en.headline: Customs seizes 36 kg ketamine and 21 kg cannabis at airport, arrests four
en.dek: Two British nationals, a Malaysian man and a local woman were stopped after officers found the drugs in check-in luggage on flights from London and Bangkok; one faces court today.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected three drug trafficking cases at Hong Kong International Airport on 28 and 29 July, seizing about 36 kilograms of suspected ketamine, about 21 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds and four pieces of suspected alternative smoking products with a total estimated market value of about HK$19 million. Two men and two women were arrested.

In the first case, a 20-year-old British woman and a 20-year-old British man arriving from London were found with about 36 kilograms of suspected ketamine in their respective check-in suitcases; four pieces of suspected alternative smoking products were also found on the man. In the second case, a 25-year-old Malaysian man arriving from Bangkok was found with about 10 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds. In the third case, a 21-year-old local woman arriving from Bangkok was found with about 11 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds.

The Malaysian man has been charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug and appeared at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on 30 July. Investigations into the other two cases continue. Customs said it would keep applying a risk-assessment approach focused on passengers from high-risk regions and reminded the public not to carry unknown items for others.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲36公斤氯胺酮及21公斤大麻花 拘四人
zh.dek: 兩名英國籍旅客、一名馬來西亞男子及一名本地女子在倫敦及曼谷航班行李中被發現毒品，其中一人今日提堂。
body: 香港海關於7月28日及29日在香港國際機場偵破三宗販毒案，檢獲約36公斤懷疑氯胺酮、約21公斤懷疑大麻花及四件懷疑另類吸煙產品，估計市值約1,900萬元，兩男兩女被捕。
第一宗案中，一名20歲英國籍女子及一名20歲英國籍男子由倫敦抵港，關員在他們各自的托運行李中發現合共約36公斤懷疑氯胺酮，另在該名男子身上發現四件懷疑另類吸煙產品。第二宗案中，一名25歲馬來西亞男子由曼谷抵港，托運行李藏有約10公斤懷疑大麻花。第三宗案中，一名21歲本地女子由曼谷抵港，托運行李藏有約11公斤懷疑大麻花。
第二宗案的馬來西亞男子已被控一項販運危險藥物罪，今日在西九龍裁判法院應訊。其餘兩宗案件仍在調查。海關表示會繼續以風險評估方式，重點檢查來自高風險地區的旅客，並提醒市民切勿為金錢報酬參與販毒，亦不要替人攜帶不明物品。
